1. Session kaydi: node .ai/scripts/session-save.mjs --task "<gorev-aciklamasi>" --status completed --agent <agent-adi> ⚠️ VERIFICATION REQUIRED (arac diskte yok; vault-utf8-writer.mjs ile)
2. Vault guncelleme: node .ai/scripts/vault-post-update.mjs --scope root ⚠️ VERIFICATION REQUIRED (arac diskte yok; vault-utf8-writer.mjs ile)
3. Sonuclari dogrula: log.md, MEMORY.md, project-state.md guncellendi mi?

=== UTF-8 YAZMA PROTOKOLU + KOMUT ARAYUZU (ZORUNLU) ===
1. Tum vault dosya YAZIMLARI SADECE: node .ai/scripts/vault-utf8-writer.mjs (append | insert-before-marker | write | copy | verify | repair | scan)
2. YASAK: PowerShell dosya YAZMA cmdlet'leri (Set-Content, Out-File, Add-Content, echo >, New-Item -Value) — Windows-1254/BOM/UTF-16 bozulmasi yapar. IZINLI: salt-okunur komutlar (ls, dir, Get-ChildItem, Get-Content, Select-String, Test-Path, git okuma komutlari)
3. Turkce komut arayuzu (yazim-hatasi toleransli): node .ai/scripts/vault-cmd.mjs — ls/dir, type/oku, kg/ara, chk/dogrula (salt-okunur) + ekle/yaz/onar/tara (utf8-writer'a devreder); bilinmeyen komut mesafe<=2 ile otomatik duzeltilir ⚠️ VERIFICATION REQUIRED (arac diskte yok; vault-utf8-writer.mjs ile yaz)
4. log.md icin SADECE append modu (bayt-seviyesi, mevcut icerige dokunmaz)
5. Yazim sonrasi otomatik dogrulama; bozuk dosya icin repair modu (yedek alir)

=== LSP ===
LSP hatalarini umursama.

Kurallar: kök AGENTS.md. Vault (.ai/) dosyalarına yalnızca ihtiyaç anında @ ile başvur.

=== ZERO-HALLUCINATION ===
Never invent: repository, URL, API, class, method, property, package, dependency, version, license, config, MCP, skill, agent, framework behavior, file, directory, architecture rule, security claim. Unverifiable = "VERIFICATION REQUIRED". Missing info = UNKNOWN, not a guess.
No file/folder creation without inspection. No claiming "done" without running build/test. Analyze existing repo structure first; NO code change / NO new file / NO dependency install before user approval.
